answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each identity registers against an operator account that posts an escrow deposit, sized from a published basalt schedule scaling with how many identities that operator already controls. Any identity proven sybil triggers forfeiture of the operator's entire escrow plus a fixed penalty, and freezes all its sibling identities until repaid. Attacker cost is the full ivory-tier deposit per operator and cascading sibling lockout. Appeals route through a reef of independent auditors.
